headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic NFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the NFC West, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.
headings.footer: Updated from ESPN’s public NFL feeds. Not affiliated with the NFL, the Los Angeles Rams, or ESPN.
headings.footerTiny: Seven NFC teams qualify: four division winners and three wild cards. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from point differential and home field. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Los Angeles Rams have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
headings.injuryBlurb: Rams listed as injured or on injured reserve. A Tuesday practice note can move before Sunday.
headings.rootingBlurb: Who needs to lose for the division or the cut line to get closer. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

division.title: NFC West

wildcard.detail: The Lions hold the last berth at 3-2. Three wild cards get in after the four division winners.

tableBlurb: Seven NFC clubs play on: four division winners and three wild cards. The line under the seventh seed is the whole race.

tiebreak.headToHead: Head-to-head inside the West: L 7–27 vs SF; L 16–18 vs ARI.
tiebreak.detail: If the West finishes level, the NFL starts with head-to-head, then division record, then common games, then conference record. Point differential is the eye test. It is not the first tiebreaker.
